title: A Structure-Preserving Decorated Particle Method for the Vlasov-Poisson System
summary: We revisit the Scovel-Weinstein framework (Scovel & Weinstein, CPAM 1994) for reducing the Vlasov-Poisson system while preserving its Hamiltonian structure. Standard particle-in-cell (PIC) algorithms approximate the distribution function by macro-particles with position and velocity. In contrast, Scovel-Weinstein decorated particles involve additional shape degrees of freedom, while maintaining a finite-dimensional reduction with Hamiltonian structure inherited from the continuum model.
